verdict.rationale: Instinct's Terms document a training opt-out: users can stop their Materials being used to train AI models via app.instinct.com/settings. Materials stored in the Vault are excluded from training entirely. Community screenshots of an earlier ToS granting a training license show the default posture, but they don't contradict the documented opt-out. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent confirmation that the opt-out works, no detail on what the setting covers (e.g., indexed email or connected-service data, retroactive effect), and training is on by default rather than off.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: If you do not want us to use your Materials to train AI models, you can opt out by visiting app.instinct.com/settings.
we will only use such Materials to provide the Services to you and will not use such Materials to train AI models.
